capability_claim: Creative collateral requests route to creative-production without taking product UI Design authority, and final generation is claimed only when an authorized host-native capability actually produces an artifact.

input.prompt: Create art direction and a logo brief for a modern B2B security startup.

invariants.criterion: Selects CREATE_CREATIVE_ASSET/creative-production rather than product UI Design.
Uses logo/CIP evidence and produces a bounded creative brief.

forbidden_behaviors: Routes logo collateral to product Visual Contract owner

input.prompt: Redesign the authenticated analytics dashboard for better task completion.

invariants.criterion: Routes to product UX/Visual Design rather than creative-production.

forbidden_behaviors: Treats product screen redesign as collateral

input.prompt: Generate the final banner image now.

invariants.criterion: Returns BLOCKED/UNAVAILABLE for final generation and does not add an external provider fallback.
Does not claim an image artifact exists.

forbidden_behaviors: Claims generated artifact from prompt text

input.prompt: Define the visual direction for an investor metrics slide and produce the slide file if the host presentation capability exists.

invariants.criterion: Owns slide visual direction but delegates actual slide-file generation to an available host presentation capability.

forbidden_behaviors: Creates a duplicate slide wrapper owner

input.prompt: Make a promotional banner that will be embedded in a product page whose approved Visual Contract constrains tokens and typography.

invariants.criterion: Preserves the approved Visual Contract for product-surface constraints while owning collateral direction.

forbidden_behaviors: Silently replaces approved product UI token/typography truth

input.prompt: Generate a final corporate identity system but no brand name, legal mark, audience, or required deliverables are supplied.

invariants.criterion: Keeps irreversible brand/deliverable gaps explicit and returns PARTIAL/BLOCKED rather than inventing final authority.

forbidden_behaviors: Claims final approved identity from missing brand constraints
